Coram: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANIL KUMAR CHOUDHARY

For the Petitioner : Mr. Kaushik Sarkhel , Adv.
 Mr. Santosh Kr. Shukla , Adv.
 For the State : Mr. Santosh Kr. Shukla , Addl..
PP 06 / 12.03.2025 Heard the parties.

Apprehending his arrest, the petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail in connection with Karmatar P.S. Case No. 56 of 2024 registered under Sections 376 of the Indian Penal Code.

Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that the allegation against the petitioner is that the petitioner committed rape upon the informant victim after developing friendship with her on promise of marriage.
It is then submitted that the allegations against the petitioner are all false and those allegations are general and omnibus in nature.

Drawing attention of the Court to the page 4-6 of the supplementary affidavit dated 28.02.2025, it is further submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the same is the certified copy of the petition filed by the informant in the court of learned CJM, Jamtara, wherein the informant-victim has categorically stated that both the petitioner and the victim are major persons and the informant on being instigated by her father,
filed the case against the petitioner but afterwards, there was settlement between the party and the informant does not want to continue with the case.

It is next submitted that the petitioner is ready to co-operate with the investigation of the case and also undertakes to furnish sufficient security Subhas Kumar Mandal @ Subhas Mandal @ ... vs The State Of Jharkhand ...

It is further submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner undertakes not to annoy or disturb the informant in any manner during pendency of the case hence, the petitioner be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.
The learned Addl. PP opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner.
Considering aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, I am inclined to grant the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Hence, in the event of arrest by the police or surrender within a period of six weeks from the date of this order, the petitioner shall be released on bail on depositing Rs. 10,000/- as cash security and on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned CJM, Jamtara in connection with Karmatar P.S. Case No. 56 of 2024 subject to the condition that the petitioner will not annoy or disturb the informant in any manner during pendency of the case and will co-operate with the Investigation of the case and will appear before the Investigating Officer as and when noticed by him and will submit mobile number and photocopy of Aadhaar card at the time of surrender in the court below with an undertaking not to change mobile phone number during the pendency of the case along with the other conditions laid down under section 438 (2) Cr. P.C..
(ANIL KUMAR CHOUDHARY, J.) Smita/-
